subject: Invoice hold: retainage + ledger lock causing token mismatch (Lighthouse Analytics)
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@lighthouseanalytics.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lighthouseanalytics.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discrepancy on invoice and sudden usage spike — request hold

Hi Sergio,

We put this month's payment on hold after receiving invoice #2026-08-01 — there's a ~48% usage jump compared to last month that we didn't expect. The invoice references a retained amount and an unusual postpay line item labelled "session reconciliation". Can you share the raw usage that produced the charge?

I've attached the invoice and our quick internal spike chart. We need itemized token counts by hour from 2026-07-30 00:00 to 2026-08-01 12:00 to reconcile with our logs. If this is an error, please advise on the credit path.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Finance
Lighthouse Analytics

Attachment: invoice_20260801.pdf (application/pdf)

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@lighthouseanalytics.com>, procurement@lighthouseanalytics.com
Date: 2026-08-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Discrepancy on invoice and sudden usage spike — request hold

Team — forwarding Emma's note. Lighthouse put payment on hold. They asked for hourly token counts and evidence. Early thought: we had a brief ledger locking incident during our midnight migration window last Friday that could have caused duplicate attribution across two ingest pipelines. Ben, can you pick this up and pull hourly export + audit snippet, and advise on provisional credit? Kim, ping accounting for VAT handling if credit applies.

I'll stay on thread with the customer for timing.

— Sergio
Director, Customer Billing & Escalations
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, Emma Liu <emma@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Cc: procurement@lighthouseanalytics.com
Date: 2026-08-03T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on invoice and sudden usage spike — request hold

Hi all — I pulled the exports and did a preliminary triage. Findings: 

- Root cause: during a control-plane migration on 2026-07-31 between 23:40 and 01:10 UTC we observed a transient ledger lock that caused a subset of prestart sessions to be replayed into the poststart pipeline. That produced duplicate session-attribution records for org_id LH-4762 in the hour window 2026-07-31T23:00:00Z -> 2026-08-01T01:00:00Z.
- Scope: ~1.9M additional tokens were attributable to duplicated writes (approximately 6.2% of the month's billable tokens for Lighthouse).
- Evidence attached: usage_sample_20260731-20260801.csv (hourly snapshots) and audit_log_snippet.txt (control-plane timestamps and transaction IDs).

Proposed remediation: 
1) Temporary retainage release: offer a provisional credit of $8,200 to remove the duplicated tokens pending final reconciliation.
2) Final audit: we'll run a full token-de-dup job and confirm final numbers within 7 business days.
3) VAT handling: if Lighthouse is VAT liable, we'll issue credit gross of VAT and coordinate with your finance team for reverse-charge/adjustment. Kim, can you confirm accounting's preferred flow?

Emma — does the provisional credit and timeline work to unblock payment? If you need token-level delta files (per-request ids) we can provide a redacted CSV.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Billing Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage_sample_20260731-20260801.csv, audit_log_snippet.txt

From: Finance - Lighthouse <finance@lighthouseanalytics.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@lighthouseanalytics.com>, procurement@lighthouseanalytics.com
Date: 2026-08-04T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on invoice and sudden usage spike — request hold

Hi Ben / Sergio,

Thanks for the quick investigation and the attachments. A few clarifying asks before we release the hold: 

1) We need the per-request ID delta for the duplicated window (redacted is fine) so our SREs can cross-check against our ingest logs.
2) Please confirm the exact invoice line(s) that will be adjusted and whether the credit will be applied to invoice #2026-08-01 or as a separate credit memo. We need the documentation for our auditors.
3) VAT: Lighthouse is VAT-registered in the US/UK. We need the credit to show VAT reversal where applicable (or a note that the credit is gross with instructions for reverse-charge reconciliation).

If you can send the redacted delta and a draft credit memo PDF, we can aim to clear the payment hold within 48 hours.

Best,
Marta Jensen
Manager, Accounts Payable
Lighthouse Analytics

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Finance - Lighthouse <finance@lighthouseanalytics.com>, Emma Liu <emma@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Credit memo and delta files for ledger-lock duplication (LH-4762)

Hi Marta / Emma —

Appreciate the patience. We've completed the dedup run and attached the redacted per-request delta for the impacted window. Summary below: 

- Impact window: 2026-07-31T23:40:00Z -> 2026-08-01T01:10:00Z
- Duplicated billable tokens removed: 1,912,432 tokens
- Gross provisional credit issued: $8,200.00 (applied as a credit memo to invoice #2026-08-01).
- VAT: credit memo shows the gross amount with VAT reversal note. If you prefer a net-only credit, we can reissue the memo; let us know your preference and VAT registration details for documentation.

Attachments we just uploaded: redacted_delta_20260731-20260801.csv, credit_memo_LH-4762.pdf. Links: HubSpot deal LH-4762 for internal notes and the credit memo record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4762).

Next steps: 
- Lighthouse: confirm acceptance of the credit memo and whether you want a net-only or gross credit display for VAT purposes. If accepted, please confirm and we'll mark the invoice as "resolved" and remove the payment hold.
- Redwood: accounting will post the credit within 24 hours of confirmation and export an accounting adjustment report for your audit.

If anything else is required for your auditors (signed statement, chain-of-custody for the de-dup job), we will provide it.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Billing & Escalations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_delta_20260731-20260801.csv, credit_memo_LH-4762.pdf
